probes.name: getUserMedia reachable in a secure context
probes.detail: getUserMedia present.

probes.name: Rear camera opens and streams
probes.detail: facingMode=environment, 1920x1080, label="Back Triple Camera"

probes.name: Frame captured to an encrypted blob with no file picker
probes.detail: 1080x1920, 246879 B, sha256=a678a2c64a960bde7eb9d048b3757cc9…, stored encrypted.

probes.name: No gallery fallback is reachable from the capture flow
probes.detail: Confirmed by tester.

probes.name: Camera-attested source metadata
probes.detail: Canvas capture yields no EXIF, no camera signature, and no device attestation. Provenance can only be app-generated, so it is only as trustworthy as the client, which is unattested on the web.

probes.name: Web Crypto subtle available
probes.detail: crypto.subtle present.

probes.name: Package key is non-extractable
probes.detail: extractable=false and exportKey rejected (InvalidAccessError).

probes.name: Key survives storage round-trip and still decrypts
probes.detail: CryptoKey structured-cloned into IndexedDB and decrypted correctly after re-read.

probes.name: Hardware-backed, user-authentication-bound key custody
probes.detail: No web API binds an AES CryptoKey to hardware or to device unlock. The key is protected by origin isolation only. A platform authenticator is present, but WebAuthn gates authentication, not key custody, and cannot wrap or release this key.

probes.name: Storage marked persistent
probes.detail: Refused while running as a plain tab. Re-measure after installing to the home screen, which is the shipping configuration.

probes.name: Quota headroom for a field package
probes.detail: 41231 MB free of 41232 MB quota.

probes.name: Writes commit atomically
probes.detail: 1 → 6 records, 0 malformed.

probes.name: Records survive a force-quit
probes.detail: Confirmed by tester.

probes.name: Records survive a seven-day dwell
probes.detail: Confirmed by tester.

probes.name: Service worker registered and controlling
probes.detail: scope=https://rozine-d04-harness.pages.dev/

probes.name: Background Sync drains the queue without the app open
probes.detail: SyncManager is absent. The queue can only drain while the app is open and foregrounded.

probes.name: Duplicate and reordered submissions commit exactly once
probes.detail: 5 submissions of 3 distinct items → 3 committed, 2 rejected as duplicates.

probes.name: Chunked upload resumes across an interruption
probes.detail: Interrupted at chunk 3 (HTTP 503); resumed to all 8 chunks committed once each.

probes.name: Real airplane-mode enqueue and reconnect drain
probes.detail: Confirmed by tester.

probes.name: Mock or spoofed location is detectable
probes.detail: The Geolocation API exposes no mock-provider flag and no provider identity. A developer-options mock location, a patched browser, or devtools sensor override is indistinguishable from a real fix. Only weak heuristics remain: implausible inter-fix speed, constant accuracy, and identical repeated coordinates.

probes.name: Device and app integrity attestation
probes.detail: No web equivalent of App Attest or Play Integrity is available. The page cannot prove it is unmodified, cannot prove the device is not rooted or emulated, and cannot prevent a modified client from submitting fabricated captures with valid-looking provenance.

probes.name: Capture timestamps resist a tampered device clock
probes.detail: Wall clock and monotonic origin agree to 0 ms, but both derive from the same settable device clock. Mitigation is a server-signed time token issued with the offline package plus monotonic deltas since package open; that bounds drift within a session but cannot establish absolute time offline.

probes.name: Package self-expires and shreds on open
probes.detail: Client-enforced TTL evaluates on open and can trigger a shred without the network.

probes.name: Revocation on next contact
probes.detail: Check-in path works, so revocation lands whenever the device reconnects. Until then the package stays readable.

probes.name: Out-of-band remote wipe
probes.detail: ReferenceError: Can't find variable: Notification

probes.name: Residual risk of an indefinitely offline device
probes.detail: Confirmed by tester.

probes.name: Crypto-shredding renders evidence unreadable
probes.detail: Ciphertext is unrecoverable after key destruction (OperationError).

probes.name: Stores and database delete cleanly
probes.detail: All evidence and queue records removed.

probes.name: Verified erasure of the underlying media
probes.detail: No browser API overwrites or verifies erasure of the physical storage behind IndexedDB. Crypto-shredding is the compensating control and must be the approved erasure standard if Option A proceeds.
